== Biography ==
The inherited account reports John Glasgow born on 19 April 1755 in Glasgow, Lanarkshire, and christened there on 23 April 1755. The maintained catalogue retains its existing birth bound of before 19 April; the newly inspected transcript gives only birth year and 23 April baptism, so it does not settle that birthday claim. The indexed parents are Hugh Glasgow and Margtt. McKechny. The selected father [[Glasgow-1929|Hugh Glasgow]] remains 94%; the inherited biography links the mother as [[McCachen-1|Margaret McCachen]], while the current structured profile compares McEachin-120. Those maternal identities remain unassessed and unreconciled; no attachment is changed.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' Glasgow, Lanarkshire, John Glasgow, 19 Apr 1755; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VRS2-MNP ARK:VRS2-MNP].</ref>

John’s father Hugh was baptised in Kilwinning in 1710 and later migrated to Kilmarnock, where his first child in that parish, [[Glasgow-3468|Ann (Glasgow) Douglas]], was born in 1749. This places John as part of the first generation of Glasgows firmly settled in Kilmarnock.

On 17 September 1788, John married [[Wyllie-1278|Margaret (Wyllie) Glasgow]] in Kilmarnock.<ref>''Scotland, Marriages, 1561–1910,'' Kilmarnock OPR, John Glasgow and Margaret Wyllie, 17 Sep 1788; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XT27-BQ5 ARK:XT27-BQ5].</ref> They had nine known children, all christened in Kilmarnock parish:

* [[Glasgow-3390|Margaret Glasgow]], chr. 29 Mar 1789.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Margaret Glasgow, 29 Mar 1789; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XBLJ-YM8 ARK:XBLJ-YM8].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3051|John Glasgow]], b. 24 Jan 1791, chr. 27 Jan 1791; later married [[Gemmill-363|Janet Gemmill]] and worked as a weaver and Chelsea Pensioner.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for John Glasgow, 27 Jan 1791; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTVR-Q89 ARK:XTVR-Q89].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3391|Hugh Glasgow]], b. 6 Dec 1792, chr. 7 Feb 1793; d. 12 Oct 1867, Kilmarnock, muslin weaver & pensioner.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Hugh Glasgow, 7 Feb 1793; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTV5-N4Z ARK:XTV5-N4Z].</ref><ref>''Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855–1875, 1881, 1891,'' death of Hugh Glasgow, 12 Oct 1867; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XSHQ-F12L ARK:XSHQ-F12L].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3392|William Glasgow]], b. 16 Jul 1795, chr. 19 Jul 1795.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for William Glasgow, 19 Jul 1795; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTV5-D4K ARK:XTV5-D4K].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3297|Ninian Glasgow]], b. 2 Dec 1797, chr. 18 Jan 1798; d. 20 Sep 1867, Tillicoultry, Clackmannanshire.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Ninian Glasgow, 18 Jan 1798; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XYQC-BL2 ARK:XYQC-BL2].</ref><ref>''Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855–1875, 1881, 1891,'' death of Ninian Glasgow, 20 Sep 1867; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XSSL-1SJD ARK:XSSL-1SJD].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3393|George Glasgow]], chr. 23 Mar 1800; d. 1857 in Milton, Glasgow.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for George Glasgow, 23 Mar 1800; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTV5-X46 ARK:XTV5-X46].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3394|Thomas Glasgow]], chr. 1 Oct 1802.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Thomas Glasgow, 1 Oct 1802; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XTV5-D51 ARK:XTV5-D51].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3395|Margaret Glasgow]], b. 9 Feb 1805.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Margaret Glasgow, 9 Feb 1805; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XBLJ-188 ARK:XBLJ-188].</ref>
* [[Glasgow-3396|Jean Glasgow]], b. 2 Feb 1807.<ref>''Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950,'' entry for Jean Glasgow, 2 Feb 1807; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:XBLV-Z3L ARK:XBLV-Z3L].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-1929]] is assessed at 94% (proved). John’s 1755 Glasgow baptism names Hugh Glasgow and Margtt McKechny. Hugh-1929’s maintained family includes Margaret McEachin/McGechan and the earlier Kilmarnock child sequence. The uncommon full couple and ordered family favour the same adult across the two towns.

Record child and parental household94%; spelling variants and the Kilmarnock-to-Glasgow continuity remain inferential. The 1792/1797 John entries concern this son’s own fatherhood, not his father.

Next useful test: Compare the 1755 original with the earlier couple for occupation or residence.

Source basis already held: [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VRS2-MNP Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950, Glasgow, Lanarkshire, John Glasgow, 19 Apr 1755; FamilySearch (accessed 21 Sep 2025) ARK:VRS2-MNP (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VRS2-MNP).]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.



* Strong evidence supports combining this profile with [[Glasgow-3471|John Glasgow (1755–)]], as both share identical parentage, birth year, and geographic context.
* The family’s migration from Kilwinning to Kilmarnock is marked by the 1749 baptism of Ann Glasgow, daughter of Hugh Glasgow and Margaret McCachen, in Kilmarnock.
* Onomastics strengthen the link: the appearance of the Gemmill name in John’s son’s marriage (Janet Gemmill) echoes maternal naming patterns (Mary Gemill was Hugh Glasgow’s mother).
* [[Glasgow-1065|John Glasgow (abt.1683–)]] of Kilwinning married [[Wyllie-1044|Jean (Wyllie) Glasgow (abt.1682–)]]. This John Glasgow is likely their great-grandson via [[Glasgow-2464|John Glasgow (1703–)]] and Hugh Glasgow (1710).
* The Old Parish Record of son [[Glasgow-3297|Ninian Glasgow (1797–1867)]] confirms parental names.

=== Inspected baptism transcript, 24 October 2026 ===
An inspected Findmypast derivative transcript gives John Glasgow’s baptism as 23 April 1755 at Glasgow, Lanarkshire, naming Hugh Glasgow and Margtt. McKechny. Its separate birth field supplies the year 1755 only. The 19 April birth date in this biography remains based on the earlier FamilySearch citation; the new transcript confirms the baptism and named couple, without independently proving that birth day or the adult-profile identification of Margaret. Hugh-1929’s existing scoped 94% father assessment and the separate unassessed mother identity remain unchanged. The original Glasgow register was not inspected.<ref>[https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_22094613969&tab=this Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929, John Glasgow, baptised 23 April 1755, Glasgow, Lanarkshire; derivative transcript inspected 24 October 2026, original register uninspected.]</ref>
